paragraphs: KNOWiNK sells the Poll Pad electronic poll book system, which handles voter check-in and verification at the polls. Poll Pad is offered as a replacement for paper poll books, which the page calls a cause of long lines at the polls and of inefficient election record keeping. Poll Pad includes ePulse, a centralized election management interface supporting real-time data transfer and audit capabilities.

The wider product suite adds a paper ballot printing system built to give election officials the right quantity of ballots for every election. A voter registration and election management system covers the accuracy and integrity of election information. The pages name jurisdictions and election officials as the users, and say the software reduces preparation time and simplifies election administration.
KNOWiNK is based in St. Louis and was founded by Scott Leiendecker. The company describes itself as family-owned and reports more than 150 employees.

quote.text: Fast and secure voter verification to replace the outdated and inefficient paper poll books that are often the cause of long lines at the polls and inefficient election record keeping.
